text:
Carmen Alvarez: Heads up  Marcus's 40th is next Thursday (June 3). Thinking we do a surprise lunchtime potluck + a short roast. Low-key, no giant signs. Thoughts? :birthday:
Sam Park: Love a potluck. Can do savory vegan mains and make sure there's a GF option.
Devon O'Neil: I can bring empanadas (vegan option too). What time are we aiming for?
Carmen Alvarez: Target 12:30pm in Kitchen B  we'll tell him there's a "knowledge-sharing lunch". Keep it hush hush.
Noah Patel: I'll order a small gluten-free cake and grab candles. Also quirky mini-gift idea: a retro mixtape playlist with 80s/90s jams. Marcus would die. :boom:
Riley Gomez: Playlist = amazing. I can make a collaborative playlist link for people to add songs.
Sam Park: Remote folks? Maybe send e-cards + a short live stream so they can wave in the chat.
Devon O'Neil: I'll set up a laptop in the corner for Zoom, mute until the reveal.
CelebrationBot: Reminder created: "Marcus 40th potluck surprise" on 2026-06-03 12:20 ET.
Carmen Alvarez: Okay volunteers: Sam (potluck coordination + GF label tags), Devon (zoom/photo), Noah (cake & candles), Riley (playlist), I'll handle invites and the 'cover' story.
Sam Park: I'll make a shared doc for food items and allergies. Please add what youre bringing by Tue EOD.
Noah Patel: Quick poll: do we want candles or sparklers? Candles are safer but less dramatic.
Riley Gomez: Candles. Also confetti-free please  lab next door is sensitive.
Carmen Alvarez: Agreed, no confetti. Also if remote folks want a care package, DM me addresses. Small budget ok.
Devon O'Neil: Who's doing the roast? Two-minute friendly jabs only. I volunteer to emcee.
Sam Park: I'll help with jokes; must be work-appropriate. :grimacing:
Carmen Alvarez: @here react with :thumbsup: if you can make it in person, or :wave: if you'll pop on Zoom.
Noah Patel: :thumbsup:
Riley Gomez: :wave: (will join Zoom from APAC)
Devon O'Neil: :thumbsup:
Sam Park: :thumbsup:
Carmen Alvarez: Thanks team. I'll drop the invite and the potluck sheet. Keep the surprise quiet! :shushing_face:
